system.description: Drawing from ancient bargains, the sorcerer evokes a disembodied mouth and eye of golden light. The golden eye can read any text (though not codes or ciphers) and the mouth can translate and recite whatever the eye reads. The mouth will pause in its dictation if the sorcerer asks, but it will not translate the same text twice for a single sorcerer, nor repeat itself if the sorcerer mishears or is distracted during the translation. The eye and the mouth consent to only 10 minutes of servitude per day before they return whence they came.
